coverageNote: First edition: six independently reviewed reports, plus discovery checks on public X, Reddit and official news. The ledger contains 112 source records and 75 recurring entrypoints. Thirty-six records were checked or surfaced with individual access notes; unvisited sources remain explicitly unverified. Coverage is bounded, not internet-wide.
limitations: No exhaustive internet crawl or complete social timeline history
No API/model execution, benchmark reproduction, audio listening or measured learning outcomes
Four baseline reports retain unknown publication dates
Chrome: five recorded navigation/connection issues across workers/coordinator, all readable through recovery or public fallback
Worker/parent token and monetary billing telemetry unavailable; no spend or savings estimate claimed
Not all registered sources were visited in this bootstrap; direct-page, profile-card and search-only observations are distinguished in the ledger.
Models and products were researched from sources, not independently benchmarked or tested.
